reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount so server callers get the rule, but re-derives the 7.5% cent-rounded tolerance inline instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The tolerance formula 'Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)' duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, so matching and planning tolerances can now drift apart.

placement.why: The worst-case rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, which already owns the range rule; callers only pass their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its call sites and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: An optional positional op after a boolean (getScheduledAmount(x, false, op)) is easy to forget, and several callers silently don't pass it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount computes the approximate tolerance itself rather than using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance expression is a recognisable inline copy of getApproxNumberThreshold, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in getScheduledAmount but is opt-in through an optional op: server/schedules/app.ts (amount-action sync, ~line 162) and the desktop-client callers (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, etc.) still call it without the op and keep the exact value.
